data.description:
One ticket, one delegator, one PR. Ratified contract: sequence/multi-event-design.md (§2 design, §3 rulings, §4 build order) + visual companion prototypes/multi-event/index.html (Flight Deck; extends binding prototype v1.11 per DESIGN.md).

Scope, in build order:
1. Events API + copy engine: GET /api/v1/events (org-scoped list w/ role, status, demo_mode, dates, submission counts) and POST /api/v1/events — one transaction, optional copy_from + copy sets (formats, tracks, forms-closed, task templates, email templates, eval-plan structure; venues toggle default-off; committees/people-data never), fresh IDs w/ remapped internal refs, response reports per-set copy counts. Slug auto-derived, 409+suggestion on per-org collision. demo_mode inherits 1 iff org = demo org; never client-settable.
2. Demo ruling (ratified): reset sweeps the demo ORG — every WHERE event_id='evt_aie-ny-2026' in reseed-demo.ts becomes the org-subquery form. Coordination point with T-O run discipline.
3. Event context: EventProvider in AppShell (first createContext in src/ui) — boot on GET /events, precedence ?event= → sessionStorage → localStorage → demo_event_id → first. Sweep ALL 16 hardcoded evt_aie-ny-2026 default props to REQUIRED eventId props (typechecker kills the bug class). QuickSearch scoped. eventName wired from the same object (absorbs T-N1's shell-name half — coordinate if T-N1 lands first). Switch = context update + navigate /dashboard with key={eventId} remount.
4. UI: switcher popover in sidebar (v1.11 geometry: current block + ＋; LIVE/DRAFT/DEMO chips, dates+submission gauges mono, upcoming/past groups, arrow/Enter/Escape, filter only past 8 events); ⌘K gains 'Switch to …' rows (NO new global chord — ratified); /conferences/new with three choice cards (scratch · from existing · Sessionize) + 'Clone from existing event' checklist with per-set counts + never-copies text; create lands on new event's dashboard with receipt toast.
5. Agent surface: CLI marquee events list / events create --name … [--from … --copy …]; SKILL.md 'next year's conference' recipe.
6. Teeth: evt_aie-ny-2026 forbidden-literal check in scripts/checks/ (outside seed/fixtures/tests); API tests (slug collision, copy remapping, demo_mode inheritance, org-sweep reset); smoke: create event via UI, open its /submissions and /dashboard — honest empty states, no 500 (CFP-S1 step 12).

AC (rubric floor): CFP-17 — second event created via switcher ＋, both coexist, reachable from popover list. CFP-18 — switching observably rescopes every gauge, list, and search. Reset leaves no created events behind. No live mail can originate from the demo org (shouldSuppress rides demo_mode — see design doc §1.6).

Supersedes the unminted T-M draft in sequence/eval-response-tickets.md:321. Ratified by Atin 2026-08-12 (single-ticket ruling: minimal parallelization seam, API→context→UI is one arc).
data.title: Multi-event, end to end — events API + copy engine, event context, switcher, create flow

data.body:
Pre-implementation audit complete — full report at sequence/mrq-129-audit.md (verified against github/main @ cd907d3, not the design's pinned 4b2dc09). 6 BLOCKER, 14 MAJOR, 10 MINOR, 5 NOTE. Two blockers are operator decisions, not delegator work.

BLOCKERS
B1 SCOPE COLLISION — MRQ-105 (in progress, agent:claude-opus-mrq-105, branch mrq-105-cold-start) explicitly owns "POST /api/v1/events + /conferences/new UI + switcher +" and cli/generate-skill.mjs renderSkill(). It is DO-NOT-MERGE until the competition freeze clears. MRQ-129 claims all four. Needs an operator ruling: MRQ-129 waits / MRQ-129 owns and MRQ-105 rebases / MRQ-129 scoped to what MRQ-105 does not own.
B2 STALE ARCHAEOLOGY — the design's "code truth" is 34 commits, 258 files, +17.7k lines behind main. It is 18 hardcoded sites, not 16 (FilesPage, SpeakersPage are new). Sidebar.tsx's class="event-switcher" no longer exists — MRQ-125 demoted it to div.event-context. T-N1's eventName wiring already shipped (AppShell eventName is already required; ShellEntry + useEventName in app.tsx; check-shell-truth.mjs already ships the forbidden-literal check). Six migrations landed after 0008.
B3 COPIED EVAL ROUNDS LEAK A COMMITTEE — 0010_evaluation_round_committees.sql added evaluation_rounds.committee_id REFERENCES committees(id). The copy set copies rounds and never copies committees, so a copied round points at the SOURCE event's committee: cross-event reviewer authority, plus a dangling FK after the org-sweep reset. Must be NULLed. Same class: 0009 added 4 columns to rubric_criteria — copy by discovered columns, never a hand-written list.
B4 task_templates.form_id IS UNREMAPPED — and CHECK (kind <> 'form' OR form_id IS NOT NULL) means nulling it rolls back the batch. Copy templates + forms => points at last year's form; copy templates without forms => 500 on a checkbox combination the UI offers. Missing from the design's remap list entirely.
B5 DEMO-EVENT ORACLE BREAKS — auth.routes.ts:390 is SELECT * FROM events WHERE demo_mode=1 ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 1, global, no org filter. npm run seed (DEPLOY.md:59, the production path) stamps created_at = FROZEN_NOW = 2026-08-20, eight days in the FUTURE. An event created today sorts first => demo_event_id/demo_event_name resolve to the judge's "Forward Summit 2028", which drives the shell caption, the CLI's default event, this ticket's own selection precedence, and every subsequent eval scenario's boot. Only a UI reset masks it.
B6 THE EVAL HARNESS IS TOLD NOT TO LOOK — .eval-kit/evalconfig.json submissionNotes says "MULTI-EVENT - NOT IMPLEMENTED IN THIS BUILD ... do not spend turns hunting for it." Ship without amending and CFP-17/18 stay not_found; the whole +3.0 evaporates. Gitignored third-party file => operator action, must be an explicit handoff AC.

MAJOR (headlines)
M1 No auth rule for GET/POST /api/v1/events — and principalHasGrant returns false when eventId is undefined, so a "grants" policy on a collection route 403s everyone. Precedent is authenticated + a hand-rolled org guard (tokens.routes.ts:47-61) which rejects tokens outright — that would break this ticket's own CLI verbs.
M2 POST /events mints no membership for its creator; an event-scoped program_lead is 403'd out of their own new conference. Masked in the demo org by the seeded org-wide owner.
M3 The AC "no live mail can originate from the demo org" is FALSE — consumer.ts:155 returns false for send_policy='always_live' BEFORE reading demo_mode, and enqueuePublicFormConfirmation writes always_live. demo_mode inheritance does not close it; "copied forms arrive closed" is the real containment.
M4 R2 is not swept org-wide — deleteDemoObjects is prefix-scoped to uploads/<seeded event>/ and runs before the batch. Created events orphan their partitions.
M5 mirror_outbox's delete plan is payload-JSON-scoped to one event id, not the org.
M6 EventProvider belongs in ShellEntry (app.tsx), not AppShell — /delivery-health is a separate render root and AppShell early-returns Portal/CoSpeaker/Reviewer. Also unspecified: what a reviewer or speaker seat gets when GET /events returns one event or zero.
M7 No stale-selection recovery — the org-sweep deletes the created event, resetDemo ends in location.reload(), and the precedence chain trusts sessionStorage. Candidates must be validated against the fetched list.
M8 Copy sets are NOT independent — 0010_bound_form_options binds form fields to formats/tracks BY NAME. Copy forms without them and the new event has unsubmittable forms over empty dropdowns.
M9 Date-bearing rows DO copy, contradicting the design — forms.opens_at/closes_at, evaluation_rounds.opens_at/closes_at, and task_templates.due_at (which cannot simply be nulled: CHECK ((due_at IS NULL) <> (due_offset_days IS NULL))).
M10 Copied evaluation_plans.status is unspecified (no CHECK on the column) while forms get an explicit "arrive closed" rule.
M11 Two of the 18 sites are not component props — venue-writer.ts uses default function parameters, DeliveryHealthShell is a separate root. QuickSearch already declares eventId required; only its call site is hardcoded.
M12 The create form must pre-fill dates. CFP-S1 step 12 gives the judge only a name; starts_on/ends_on/timezone are NOT NULL; run 1 capped at 70 turns on all four CFP scenarios and step 12 is last. The prototype pre-fills; the ticket does not say so.
M13 "Same geometry, nothing jumps" needs re-deriving against div.event-context, which replaced the link the prototype's CSS styles.
M14 Sidebar "Conference site" (/agenda) and "Speaker portal" links are event-blind — on event B they open event A.

MINOR highlights: the design's org literal 'org_demo' is WRONG (the demo org is org_aie-ny / SHIPPED_DEMO_ORGANIZATION_ID; org_demo is the legacy test fixture); the forbidden-literal check already exists in check-shell-truth.mjs (extend it); cli/api-registry.json is untracked since e3cfce6; form_fields.condition keys on fieldKey not id, so NO remap is needed there; MRQ-56's verdict already settled D1 at 100 bindings per statement, and reseedDemo's own multi-hundred-row batch is precedent — statement count is not the constraint, but the read phase is outside the write transaction.

NOTE, and it saves work: CFP-18's YAML pass criterion accepts an EMPTY second-event submissions list. The judge does not need to create a submission in event B. Do not build or spend turns on seeding it.

Clean on inspection: the 18-site enumeration is otherwise complete (nothing hides in src/jobs, SSR routes, or public routes); /conferences/new survives a hard reload (SPA fallback is on); the empty-shell audit holds, including the empty allowlist meaning suppress-all; the per-event authorization and composite-FK claims are accurate; file_comments is already in WIPE_ORDER.

data.reason: Scope collision: MRQ-105 (in progress, do-not-merge until the freeze) already owns POST /api/v1/events, /conferences/new, the switcher +, and renderSkill() — one of the two tickets must give up that scope before a delegator starts; five other blockers in sequence/mrq-129-audit.md change the design, not just the ticket text.

One ticket, one delegator, one PR. Contract: sequence/multi-event-design.md (§2 design, §3 rulings) + visual companion prototypes/multi-event/index.html.

READ sequence/mrq-129-audit.md BEFORE PLANNING. The design's §1 archaeology is pinned to 4b2dc09 and main is at cd907d3 — 34 commits, +17.7k lines past it. The audit corrects it and lists the defects this ticket must not ship. Where the design and the audit disagree, the audit is current.

SCOPE BOUNDARY — MRQ-105 owns three of these surfaces (operator ruling, 2026-08-12).
MRQ-105 (branch mrq-105-cold-start) lands FIRST and already ships:
  - POST /api/v1/events — `createEvent`, src/routes/event-settings.routes.ts. Org-wide authority via `requireOrgAdmin` (src/lib/auth/org-admin.ts), answered in the handler because a collection route has no {eventId} and the pipeline's grant check returns false without one.
  - /conferences/new + src/ui/setup/CreateConferencePage.tsx — the scratch path.
  - The sidebar ＋ beside the conference name.
  - demo_mode inheritance and per-org slug uniqueness (both fixed on that branch).
MRQ-129 EXTENDS those three. It does not create them. Branch off MRQ-105 or wait for its merge; coordinate before touching event-settings.routes.ts, CreateConferencePage.tsx, or Sidebar.tsx.

SCOPE, in build order:

1. GET /api/v1/events — NEW, no MRQ-105 counterpart. Org-scoped list of events the caller can read, with role, status, demo_mode, dates, and submission counts. Policy `authenticated` (a `grants` policy 403s every caller on a route with no {eventId} — src/api/router.ts principalHasGrant). Handler scopes to the principal's org; for a token principal, further intersect with tokenEventAllowed (scope-resolution.ts:105-109) so an event-restricted token sees only its events.

2. Copy engine — extend POST /api/v1/events with optional `copy_from` + `copy` sets per design §2.3 (formats, tracks, forms-closed, task templates, email templates, eval-plan structure; venues default-off; committees and people-data never). One db.batch. Response reports per-set counts — the receipt the UI renders. Mandatory corrections from the audit:
   - Copy by DISCOVERED columns, not a hand-written list. 0009/0010 added columns to rubric_criteria, buildings, and embeds; a literal column list silently stops copying whatever the next migration adds.
   - NULL evaluation_rounds.committee_id on copy (added by 0010_evaluation_round_committees). Copying it points the new event's round at the source event's committee — cross-event reviewer authority, and a dangling FK after the org-sweep reset.
   - REMAP task_templates.form_id -> the copied form. Missing from the design's remap list. CHECK (kind <> 'form' OR form_id IS NOT NULL) means nulling it rolls back the batch, so when any source template has kind='form' the CFP-forms set is a hard prerequisite: auto-check and lock it in the checklist with an inline reason, and 422 (never 500) if the API is called with the illegal combination.
   - The CFP-forms set also depends on Formats and Tracks whenever a copied field carries config.source (0010_bound_form_options binds them BY NAME). Copying forms without them yields unsubmittable forms over empty dropdowns.
   - Null the date-bearing columns that do copy, contradicting §2.3's "nothing date-bearing copies": forms.opens_at/closes_at and evaluation_rounds.opens_at/closes_at. task_templates.due_at cannot simply be nulled — CHECK ((due_at IS NULL) <> (due_offset_days IS NULL)) — so either derive a due_offset_days from the source event's starts_on or skip those templates and report the count in the receipt. Pick one and state it.
   - State the status a copied evaluation_plan arrives in (the column has no CHECK), the same way forms are explicitly forced closed.
   - Remaps that are NOT needed, so nobody invents them: form_fields.condition keys on fieldKey, not field id (src/lib/form-conditions.ts:27-36), and form_fields.config carries only source/minItems, no ids.

3. Reset org-sweep — every WHERE event_id = <seeded demo event> in src/lib/reset-demo/reseed-demo.ts becomes the org-subquery form. Use SHIPPED_DEMO_ORGANIZATION_ID, never a literal: the demo org is org_aie-ny; the design's 'org_demo' is the legacy test fixture. Walk DELETE_PLANS table by table — three entries are not of the form the rewrite rule assumes:
   - mirror_outbox is payload-JSON-scoped to one event id, not org-columned.
   - deleteDemoObjects (reseed-demo.ts:284) is R2-prefix-scoped to uploads/<seeded event>/ and runs BEFORE the batch. Enumerate the org's event ids first, sweep each prefix, then run the batch. R2 and D1 are not atomic with each other; say so rather than rediscovering it.
   - api_tokens and memberships already delete by org.

4. Event context — EventProvider in ShellEntry (src/ui/app.tsx), NOT in AppShell. ShellEntry already wraps both render roots and already owns useEventName (shipped by MRQ-125); a provider inside AppShell misses /delivery-health entirely and misses ReviewerPage, which AppShell early-returns before its layout. Boot on GET /events. Precedence ?event= -> sessionStorage -> localStorage -> demo_event_id -> first, and EVERY candidate is accepted only if it appears in the fetched list; a stale id is cleared from both storages (after the org-sweep reset the created event is gone, storage still names it, and resetDemo ends in location.reload()).
   Sweep all 18 hardcoded evt_aie-ny-2026 sites — 18 on current main, not the design's 16; FilesPage and SpeakersPage are new. Page components take eventId: string REQUIRED. Two are not component props: venue-writer.ts uses default function parameters on loadVenueModel/saveVenueModel, and DeliveryHealthShell is the separate root. QuickSearch already declares eventId required — only its call site (AppShell.tsx:183) is hardcoded.
   Specify what a reviewer or speaker seat gets when GET /events returns one event or zero; a required eventId prop with no value to fill it is not a design.
   Switch = context update + navigate /dashboard with key={eventId} remount, and abort outstanding requests rather than relying on the remount to make late responses harmless.

5. UI — the switcher POPOVER (MRQ-105 ships only the ＋; the conference name is still MRQ-125's div.event-context caption). Promote the caption to a real control per §2.6: LIVE/DRAFT/DEMO chips, dates and submission gauges in mono, upcoming/past groups, arrow/Enter/Escape, filter input only past 8 events. Reconcile .event-context (current) with .event-switcher (prototype CSS) and assert the sidebar's first-nav-row offset is unchanged — elements never jump. ⌘K gains "Switch to …" rows; NO new global chord. Extend MRQ-105's /conferences/new with the three-card choice (scratch · from existing · Sessionize) and the copy-contract checklist with per-set counts plus the never-copies text. Every field pre-filled and submittable with only a name changed — no required field empty on first paint. The switcher rewrites event-scoped external links (sidebar "Conference site" -> /agenda, "Speaker portal") with the current event's slug; today they open event A from event B.

6. Agent surface — CLI marquee events list / events create --name … [--from … --copy …]; SKILL.md gains the "next year's conference" recipe. Coordinate with MRQ-105, which owns cli/generate-skill.mjs renderSkill() under a byte-equality test.

7. Teeth — extend scripts/checks/check-shell-truth.mjs (which already ships the "AIE NYC 2026" forbidden literal) with evt_aie-ny-2026, allowlisting seed/fixtures/tests. API tests for the copy remaps and null-outs above, the illegal copy-set combinations, and the org-sweep reset. Smoke: create an event via the UI, open its /submissions and /dashboard — honest empty states, no 500.

8. Fix the demo-event oracle. src/routes/auth.routes.ts:390 is SELECT * FROM events WHERE demo_mode = 1 ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 1 — global, no org filter. npm run seed (DEPLOY.md:59, the production path) stamps created_at = FROZEN_NOW = 2026-08-20, in the future, so an event created today sorts FIRST and becomes the demo event for the shell caption, the CLI's default event, this ticket's own precedence chain, and every subsequent eval scenario's boot. Resolve by identity, not by age. Test: with two demo_mode=1 events where the created one has the earlier created_at, /auth/me still returns the seeded event.

OPERATOR HANDOFF (not delegator work): .eval-kit/evalconfig.json submissionNotes currently tells the eval agent "MULTI-EVENT — NOT IMPLEMENTED IN THIS BUILD … do not spend turns hunting for it." That paragraph and the ROUTES list must be rewritten before the next run or CFP-17/18 stay not_found regardless of what ships. The file is gitignored third-party.

AC: CFP-17 — a second event is created and both appear together in the switcher popover, screenshot-able with both rows visible. CFP-18 — switching observably rescopes every gauge, list, and search; the second event's submissions list is EMPTY, which the YAML accepts as passing (no need to seed data into event B). Reset leaves no created event behind, in D1 and in R2. An event created in the demo org inherits demo_mode = 1 and, with no event_settings row, its allowlist is the empty set so every demo_safe message is suppressed — note that always_live senders (public-form confirmation, smoke harness) bypass demo_mode by design (consumer.ts:155), which is why copied forms arrive closed.

provenance.reason: Descoped around MRQ-105 per operator ruling; corrected against main @ cd907d3 per sequence/mrq-129-audit.md

data.note: Operator ruling 2026-08-12: MRQ-105 keeps POST /api/v1/events, /conferences/new, and the switcher +; MRQ-129 descoped to extend them. Description rewritten and linked depends_on MRQ-105.

data.body: Delegator launched: c11 surface:523 in workspace:9 (Marquee), claude-code / opus / high effort, LATTICE_ROOT pinned to the primary checkout. Worktree Marquee-worktrees/mrq-129-multi-event on branch mrq-129-multi-event, cut from mrq-105-cold-start (NOT github/main) so MRQ-105's POST /api/v1/events, /conferences/new, and sidebar + are present to extend. Its PR will stack on MRQ-105's. Boot brief points it at the ticket description as the build contract and sequence/mrq-129-audit.md as the reasoning, and calls out the four load-bearing traps: discovered-column copy, the committee_id null-out and task_templates.form_id remap, EventProvider in ShellEntry not AppShell, and validating every selection candidate against the fetched event list.

Delegator started. Branch mrq-129-multi-event cut from mrq-105-cold-start (2da16c4). Read the audit + design; note both docs live UNCOMMITTED in the primary checkout (sequence/mrq-129-audit.md, sequence/multi-event-design.md, prototypes/multi-event/) — they are not in git on any branch, so I am reading them read-only from /Users/atin/Projects/Stage11/deployments/Marquee.

Plan written to .lattice/plans/task_01KZV8TM97AM2PB5W247RQGXFB.md — the copy manifest is designed table-by-table against the live schema (13 tables, per-column: copied / remapped / nulled / forced). Rulings recorded there: (a) copy by discovered columns from the returned row + a manifest<->PRAGMA table_info drift test, so a new migration can neither silently drop a column nor silently leak one; (b) task_templates carrying an absolute due_at are NOT copied and the count is reported in the receipt — due_offset_days counts from assignment (task-due.ts:57), not from the conference start, so a derived offset would be a fabricated number; (c) evaluation_plans arrive status='draft', forms arrive 'closed' with opens_at/closes_at nulled, evaluation_rounds arrive with committee_id and both dates nulled; (d) form_admins and forms.password_hash travel deliberately and the create screen says so; (e) CLI verb is 'event list' (singular root) to match the shipped registry, not 'events list'; (f) the switcher keeps the SHIPPED .event-context geometry, not the prototype's bordered box — elements never jump.

E2E validation against the real built artifact (npx vite build, then wrangler dev on the shipped bundle, local D1 seeded with npm run seed), driven through the c11 embedded browser. Not the dev server, and not the test suite: two of the defects below exist only in the shipped runtime.

WHAT I SAW WORK

- CFP-17. Signed in as the demo organizer, opened the switcher popover: BOTH conferences visible in one control, each with a DEMO chip, dates in mono, and a submission gauge (1000 subs / 0 subs), plus the "Create conference" footer row. Screenshot attached (cfp-17-both-conferences.png). Then created a third conference through the UI's three-card "from existing" path and landed on its dashboard with the receipt toast reading, verbatim: "Forward Summit 2029 created from AI Engineer New York 2026 - 49 structure records copied, nothing personal travelled." (cfp-17-created-via-ui.png)

- CFP-18. Switching rescoped everything observably: breadcrumb, sidebar caption, all seven pipeline gauges to 0, the cold-start checklist to "4 of 5" (the copy carried tracks/formats/forms/eval plan), and "Your program starts here". /submissions on the second conference reads "0 matching records - No submissions yet" while the first shows 1,000. No 500 anywhere. (cfp-18-rescoped-dashboard.png, cfp-18-empty-submissions.png)

- The copy contract on real seeded data. copy-plan returned 4 formats, 8 tracks, 2 forms / 19 fields, 6 templates, 2 rounds / 7 criteria, 3 buildings / 10 rooms - and BOTH prerequisites fired for real rather than hypothetically: the seeded form fields are bound (config.source), and "Hotel and Travel Reservations" is a kind='form' template. The illegal combination returned 422 naming that template and left the events table untouched. Verified in D1 on the created conference: demo_mode=1, status=draft, 2 forms closed with opens_at/closes_at NULL, 0 rounds carrying a committee_id, plan status draft, 0 task templates pointing at another conference's form, 0 submissions, 0 buildings (venues default-off).

- Reset. Ran the reset through the API while the browser was sitting IN the created conference: the created conference is gone from GET /events and the seeded one survives. Reloaded - the shell recovered rather than booting into a deleted conference, and after signing in again both storages had been rewritten from the ghost id to evt_aie-ny-2026. (The 401 after a reset is pre-existing: the sweep deletes every demo-org session.)

- Geometry. First nav row top = 121px before opening the switcher and 121px after. Nothing jumps.

- Keyboard and links. Cmd-K grows a "Switch to AI Engineer New York 2026 - 1000 submissions" row. Sidebar external links carry the conference: /agenda?event=forward-summit-2029, /portal?event=forward-summit-2029.

TWO DEFECTS THE SUITE COULD NOT HAVE FOUND, both fixed and committed

1. The Worker would not start. A module-scope AbortController in api-client.ts is reachable from the Worker bundle, and workerd refuses constructor work in global scope: "Disallowed operation called within global scope". Every test passed against it; the deployment died at boot. Created on first use now.

2. The popover was clipped. The sidebar is a scroll container and a scroll container clips both axes, so a 264px popover laid out inside a 224px column lost its status chips and submission gauges off the right edge - which is to say the screenshot CFP-17 is scored from would have shown a truncated control. Measured onto the viewport now, repositioned on resize and on capture-phase scroll.

ONE MORE, FOUND BY OPENING THE FRONT DOOR

The landing page carried its own copy of the age-ordered demo oracle, so once a visitor created a conference the hero, the live-program counts, and the footer byline all advertised THEIR empty conference instead of the seeded demo. Same class as the ticket's item 8, in a place the audit did not enumerate. Both callers now share one ordering clause in src/lib/demo-event.ts, and the integration test asserts the landing HTML names the seeded conference while a newer demo conference exists.
